Welcome to First Steps Pediatric Therapy!

We are a team of expert therapists who offer pediatric occupational and physical therapy for children from birth through age 18 in our community. Our services are available as clinic-based, in-home, and teletherapy to ensure your child can receive the care they need to thrive.

Give us a call at (700) 900-7432 today to schedule an evaluation and empower your child’s first steps toward a brighter future!
